summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of the BetoDecor rebuild against the public preview URL. Backend: 24 pytest cases (health, auth/JWT/bcrypt, lead creation + scoring caps, upload validation, protected file serving, admin list/filters/stats/detail/status) — all 24 PASSED. Frontend: home page (NL/FR/EN/ES switcher), full 7-step wizard happy path + validation + back-navigation data retention + submit to /bedankt, admin login (wrong + correct creds), dashboard KPIs/table sorting/3 filters, lead detail (info, media gallery with tokenized image that actually loads, score breakdown, 4 contact actions, status change + persistence after reload), logout + protected-route redirect, mobile (390px) home/wizard/footer/hamburger. All core flows work. Only 1 security deviation and 3 cosmetic issues found.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout is ineffective behind the ingress: the rate-limit key uses request.client.host, which resolves to rotating ingress pod IPs (observed 10.79.139.10 and 10.79.139.11). 6 consecutive wrong passwords produced 6x401 and split into two counter docs (count=3 each) — never reaching the 5-attempt 429 lockout. Fix: derive the client IP from X-Forwarded-For (first hop) and/or key the counter on email only.

CORS_ORIGINS="*" combined with allow_credentials=True is an invalid/ignored combination per the CORS spec (browsers reject wildcard + credentials). Harmless today because the app authenticates with a Bearer header, but should be set to explicit origins if cookie auth is ever added.

Auth playbook expects httpOnly cookie sessions; this implementation returns the JWT in the JSON body and the frontend stores it in localStorage ('beto_admin_token'). Works, but is XSS-exposed and deviates from the playbook. Additionally /api/files/{path}?token=<jwt> puts the full JWT in a URL (visible in logs/referrers).

issues: The location badge 'Zaventem · Brussel / VLAAMS-BRABANT & OMSTREKEN' sits on the bottom edge of the hero image: the text overlaps the photo and is partially clipped/illegible (low contrast against the light interior photo). Move it below the image or add a solid/blurred backdrop.

Address renders with a leading comma (', 1930 Zaventem') when straat/huisnummer are empty; the wizard does not require street/number so this is easily reachable. LeadDetail.jsx line 92 should filter empty parts before joining.
No footer / no contact details on the confirmation page (rest of the site has a full footer); page also looks very empty on a 1920x1080 viewport. Consider adding footer + next-step / contact info.

action_items: Fix login rate-limit identifier to use X-Forwarded-For (or email-only key) so the 5-attempt lockout actually triggers behind the k8s ingress.
Set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins instead of '*' while allow_credentials=True.
Cosmetic: fix hero location badge overlap/clipping, leading comma in lead-detail address, and add footer to /bedankt.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py login(): identifier = f"{request.client.host}:{email}" — behind the ingress this is the proxy pod IP and it rotates, so the lockout counter is split and never reaches MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS. Verified reproducible.
server.py: hash_password is imported but unused (seed_admin owns hashing) — dead import.

server.py serve_file(): only checks that the JWT is valid, not that the user still exists or has the admin role (unlike get_current_user). A valid-but-deleted user's token can still fetch private uploads.

scoring.py: CORE_POSTCODES_INT is defined AFTER location_score() uses it (works at call time, but is fragile ordering); CORE_POSTCODES also contains '1800'/'1950' (Vilvoorde/Wemmel) which are not in CORE_AREAS — verify this is intended since it grants full 20/20 location points.
scoring.py: NEAR_AREAS contains 'kortenberg' twice (harmless in a set, but signals copy/paste).
Wizard.jsx is 463 lines with 7 inline step components — consider splitting per-step components into /components/wizard/ for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (home, i18n, wizard 7 steps + validation, admin login/dashboard/filters/detail/status/logout, mobile)

Beware: /api/auth/login has a 5-attempt lockout per (ip,email); clear db.login_attempts after negative auth tests. Frontend confirmed clean of console/page errors on all pages tested.
rca_of_the_issue: Brute-force lockout failure RCA: FastAPI's request.client.host reflects the immediate peer (the k8s ingress/proxy pod), and this cluster fronts traffic from multiple proxy IPs. Since the lockout key is f'{ip}:{email}', failed attempts are distributed across several Mongo login_attempts documents and each stays below MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS=5, so no 429 is ever returned. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login 6x with a wrong password -> all 401; db.login_attempts then shows two docs with count=3.
